title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 15
text:
RMS fields for Limit and Ded.
Files Name RMS Fields Notes
Account File ACCNTNUM
The name of the policy or an identifying name; for inputting a single policy this name should be the 
same for each location and should match the ACCNTNUM in the Location file
Account File ACCNTNAME The name of the insured party
Account File POLICYNUM Peril Name(EQ,WS,SCS,FL,FR, TR)
Account File POLICYTYPE Peril Type(1,2,3,4,5,6)
Account File BLANLIMAMT Blanket Limit
Account File PARTOF Part Of
Account File UNDCOVAMT Excess of (Attachment Point)
Account File BLANDEDAMT Blanket Deductible
Account File INCEPTDATE The date of the first day on which coverage is effective
Account File EXPIREDATE The date of the last day on which coverage is effective
Account File MINDEDAMT Minimum / Maximum Deductible
Account File MAXDEDAMT Minimum / Maximum Deductible
Location Files EQSITELIM Coverage Limit / Coverage Deductible
Location Files EQSITEDED Site Limit / Site Deductible
Location Files EQCOMBINEDLIM Coverage Limit / Coverage Deductible
Location Files EQCOMBINEDDED Site Limit / Site Deductible
Location Files USERTXT1 User define ref. column, use to code Site level limit and ded.
Location Files USERTXT2 User define ref. column, use to code Site level limit and ded.
